Read the Full Story Initiate the AWS Well-Architected Review with Cloud4C Most Asked Questions What is AWS Well-Architected Framework? AWS Well-Architected Framework presents design principles and best practices for designing secure, efficient, cost-effective systems in the cloud based on six pillars: operational excellence, security, reliability, performance efficiency, cost optimization, and sustainability How frequently should Well-Architected Reviews be conducted? Periodic reviews every 6-8 months are recommended to optimize cloud costs and ensure continuous alignment with best practices. What does the AWS Well-Architected Review process involve? The review uses the AWS WAR Framework to evaluate and remediate systems through structured questions that check if architecture and operations align with AWS recommended practices. What deliverables can enterprises expect from Cloud4C's review? Cloud4C provides detailed review reports showing Well-Architected Framework alignment, plus actionable remediation plans for enhancing cloud architecture based on assessment findings. What is Cloud4C's role as an AWS partner? Cloud4C is an AWS Advanced Tier Services Partner with certified AWS experts who have architected, built, and migrated several workloads to AWS, following the AWS Well-Architected framework and best practices.
